ety.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic глава (glava), borrowed from Old Church Slavonic глава (glava). Doublet of голова́ (golová), the regular East Slavic reflex. Compare typologically Latin capitāneus (whence капита́н (kapitán)) < caput (whence also шеф (šef)). Also compare typologically Latin capitulum (whence English chapter), Ancient Greek κεφάλαιον (kephálaion).

ety.text: From *ka + *by. Cognate with Belarusian каб (kab), dialectal Ukrainian коби (koby) and коб (kob), Carpathian Rusyn кеби (keby).
